    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let entry_name be item 1 of parts
        let quantity_text be item 2 of parts
        let maybe_quantity be number from quantity_text
        if maybe_quantity is nothing:
            fail "expected a whole-number quantity"
        let quantity be value of maybe_quantity

        if totals contains entry_name:
            let current_total be item entry_name of totals
            set item entry_name of totals to current_total plus quantity
        otherwise:
            set item entry_name of totals to quantity

    let names be sorted keys of totals
    for each index from 1 to length of names:
        let entry_name be item index of names
        let total be item entry_name of totals
        say "{entry_name} {total}"
